info.title: API.SH: Bring a Trailer
info.description: The Bring a Trailer API from API.SH: public Bring a Trailer data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every live Bring a Trailer auction, filtered by words, make and model, year range, bid range, ending time, category, origin, era, country, no-reserve, Premium and BaT-alumni, transmission and maximum mileage, with sort and paging. Each auction has id, link, title, year, current bid, currency, end time, no-reserve and Premium flags, era, categories, location (country and coordinates), VIN where the listing shows one, excerpt, image, and `mileage` (miles), `transmission` (the gearbox as described) and `transmission_type` (manual or automatic) where the auction summary states them (null otherwise). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bringatrailer-auctions

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words that must all appear in the title or listing text (make, model, trim, chassis code, VIN...).

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make, added to the words searched (e.g. porsche).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model, added to the words searched (e.g. 911).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Categories, comma-separated: aircraft, atv, boats, charity, convertibles, diesels, electric, go_karts, hot_rods, kei, military, minibikes, motorcycles, parts, projects, race_cars, rhd, rv, service_vehicles, side_by_sides, wagons, tractors, trains, truck_4x4, vans, wheels.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origins, comma-separated: american, brazilian, british, canadian, czech, dutch, french, german, italian, japanese, korean, prewar, spanish, swedish.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Location country codes, comma-separated (US, CA, GB, DE...).

parameters.name: bat_alumni
parameters.description: true: only cars sold on BaT before.

parameters.name: ending_within_hours
parameters.description: Only auctions ending within this many hours.

parameters.name: transmission
parameters.description: Only auctions whose summary describes this gearbox. Automated manuals (dual-clutch, PDK, F1, SMG, sequential) count as automatic. Auctions that don't state a gearbox are left out.

parameters.name: mileage_max
parameters.description: Only auctions whose stated mileage is at most this many miles (kilometres are converted). Auctions that don't state a mileage are left out.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Bring a Trailer listing comments and bids
get.description:
Every comment and bid on a listing: author (and whether it is the seller), time, text, bid amount, likes, reply-to and images, newest, oldest or most-liked first; type= keeps only comments or only bids.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bringatrailer-comments

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Bring a Trailer auction: status (live, sold, reserve not met, withdrawn), current or high bid, sale price, currency, end time, bid count, comments, views, watchers, lot number, chassis/VIN, location, make, models, era, origin, categories, the BaT Essentials details list, `no_reserve`, `vehicle_specs` read from the details list (mileage in miles and as written, TMU flag, engine, transmission, transmission type, gear count, drivetrain, exterior colour, interior; each null when not stated), description, all photo URLs and the bid history shown on the page (amounts and times). Dealers are named; a private party seller is only marked as such. `latest=1` with the auctions filters opens the first current auction.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bringatrailer-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: 1: open the first auction that /bringatrailer/v1/auctions returns for the other params.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: With latest=1: words to search the live auctions for.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Bring a Trailer makes and models
get.description:
The makes and models directory: every make with its link and model count; make= (or models=true, or q=) adds each model's name, link and image. Use a model link's path with the results and auctions routes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bringatrailer-models

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only models whose name contains this.

parameters.name: models
parameters.description: true includes every make's models in the full list.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Completed Bring a Trailer auctions (sold and reserve not met) from the site's results archive, with the same filters as the site: words, year range, maximum bid, result, recency, category, origin, era, country, no-reserve, Premium and BaT-alumni, plus sort and paging. Each result has id, link, title, final bid or sale price, result text, end date, flags, image, and `mileage` (miles), `transmission` and `transmission_type` (manual or automatic) where the auction summary states them (null otherwise). `stats=true` adds the site's sold-price chart points. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bringatrailer-results

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
